display.title: Dida365 Open API
display.summary: Use OAuth 2.0 to manage Dida365 projects, tasks, comments, tags, focus records, countdowns, habits, and check-ins.

documentation.stabilityNote: Official OAuth 2.0 API. Reads and writes require user authorization and are limited by the tasks:read and tasks:write scopes.

pricing.summary: The official developer site does not publish separate Open API pricing; eligibility and subscription benefits remain subject to the Dida365 account page and official terms.

credentials.description: Dida365 OAuth 2.0 access token with tasks:read / tasks:write scopes. Enter it only in your own session.

guide.title: Create credentials in the Dida365 Developer Center
steps: Sign in to the Developer Center and create a New App.
Paste the callback URL shown by Pontx Hub into the app's OAuth Redirect URL.
Save the app, then copy its Client ID and Client Secret into the fields below.
